core_action_logic.name: OBSERVE
core_action_logic.description: Identify the people, place, resources and immediate problem.

core_action_logic.name: IDENTIFY
core_action_logic.description: Define the actual problem instead of reacting emotionally.

core_action_logic.name: PLAN
core_action_logic.description: Choose a workable sequence using available resources.

core_action_logic.name: INITIATE
core_action_logic.description: Take the first useful action; avoid passive waiting.

core_action_logic.name: COORDINATE
core_action_logic.description: Involve the right people and communicate clearly.

core_action_logic.name: EXECUTE
core_action_logic.description: Carry out the plan while adapting to new information.

core_action_logic.name: RESULT
core_action_logic.description: Show a realistic, measurable or observable outcome.

tat_framework_rules: Observe -> Identify -> Plan -> Initiate -> Coordinate -> Execute -> Result
Use the profession as a source of realistic action. Do not force a profession into the picture.
If a profession is relevant, use its knowledge, tools, responsibilities and work environment to create a practical response.
The OLQ labels are practice prompts, not a claim about how any individual candidate will be assessed.

situation_bank.title: Accident / Injury
situation_bank.description: A person is injured in a public place, workplace, or road, and nearby bystanders are panicked or uncertain what to do.
situation_bank.picture_cues: A person lying on the ground, a crowd gathered in hesitation, two individuals conferring, vehicles or road shoulder visible.

best_fit_professions.name: Traffic Police Officer
best_fit_professions.reason: Manages traffic diversion, cordons area, and summons medical assistance rapidly.

best_fit_professions.name: Paramedic / Nursing Officer
best_fit_professions.reason: Conducts immediate ABC triage (Airway, Breathing, Circulation) and stabilizes patient.

best_fit_professions.name: Site Safety Supervisor
best_fit_professions.reason: Applies workplace first aid protocol and secures site machinery to prevent secondary hazards.

situation_bank.model_story: Aakash, a 24-year-old physical training instructor, was returning home when he noticed a commuter thrown from a two-wheeler at a busy intersection. Quickly assessing that traffic was continuing dangerously close, Aakash stepped in and directed two bystanders to place warning reflectors and divert vehicles. Checking the victim, he confirmed clear breathing and applied firm pressure with a clean cloth to a bleeding forearm laceration while keeping the person warm and conscious. He had a shopkeeper call the local emergency ambulance and notified the commuter's family via their mobile phone. Once paramedics arrived, Aakash briefed them on the vital signs, helped load the stretcher, and resumed his commute after traffic normalized.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan was passing by and saw his arch-enemy bleeding to death after being attacked by terrorists. Rohan fought off the remaining terrorists with martial arts, picked the injured man on his back, and ran 15 kilometers to the city hospital without calling an ambulance.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Noticed injured commuter on road with oncoming traffic hazard.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Primary threat is secondary collision and blood loss.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Diverted traffic using bystanders; initiated first-aid pressure.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Summoned 108 ambulance via shopkeeper; briefed paramedics.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Victim stabilized, safely handed over to medical personnel; traffic cleared.

situation_bank.title: Technical Failure
situation_bank.description: A critical machine, generator, server, or transmission system fails shortly before an important operation or deadline.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Two or three people standing near open electrical panels, machinery, or engines, inspecting tools or diagnostic screens.

best_fit_professions.name: Mechanical Engineer
best_fit_professions.reason: Diagnoses physical drive, cooling, or pressure failure and uses auxiliary bypass.

best_fit_professions.name: Electrical Supervisor
best_fit_professions.reason: Inspects breaker relays, checks voltage drop, and swaps out burnt fuses.

best_fit_professions.name: Systems Administrator
best_fit_professions.reason: Activates failover cluster and inspects error logs to restore connectivity.

situation_bank.model_story: Sameer, a 26-year-old electrical maintenance engineer at an industrial bottling plant, noticed the main conveyor circuit trip 40 minutes before the scheduled export shift. Resisting the urge to blindly reset the breaker, Sameer reviewed the fault annunciator and detected an overload on the secondary drive motor. He immediately isolated the sub-panel for safety and dispatched his technician to inspect the mechanical bearings for jamming while he tested line resistance with a multimeter. Identifying a blown thermal fuse caused by accumulated dust, Sameer had the assembly cleaned, installed a verified spare fuse, and ran an unloaded test run before authorizing full production on schedule.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the machine stop. He got furious and started hitting the engine with a wrench. Miraculously, the machine started working and everyone cheered him as a genius.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Conveyor line tripped prior to shift handover.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Thermal overload trip indicating mechanical jam or electrical short.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Isolated panel for safety; delegated bearing inspection.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Worked in tandem with technician; retrieved standardized spare fuse.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Safe diagnostic repair completed; full export shift started on time.

situation_bank.title: Resource Shortage
situation_bank.description: A team discovers that an essential material, medical kit, fuel, or tool is unavailable when work is about to commence.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Individuals in a storehouse, construction site, or office reviewing an empty shelf, inventory clipboard, or ledger.

best_fit_professions.name: Storekeeper / Inventory Manager
best_fit_professions.reason: Conducts reconciliation and cross-allocates buffer stock from adjacent depots.

best_fit_professions.name: Construction Site Supervisor
best_fit_professions.reason: Re-sequences task phases so concrete setting continues while steel rebar is rerouted.

best_fit_professions.name: Camp Logistics Officer
best_fit_professions.reason: Prioritizes critical ration/fuel distribution and pools resources across units.

situation_bank.model_story: Vikram, a 25-year-old junior project manager at a water pipeline project, discovered that the high-grade PVC sealant required for joint sealing was short by 30 drums on the morning of pipe laying. Recognizing that pausing work would stall thirty contract laborers, Vikram re-sequenced the work plan: he directed the excavation crew to continue trench bedding while he contacted the neighboring district depot to negotiate a loan of 35 verified sealant drums. Coordinating dispatch with a local pickup vehicle, Vikram received the supplies by noon, conducted batch quality verification, and ensured the pipe-jointing proceeded without wage loss or deadline disruption.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan found there were no supplies. He reported his lazy team to the police for theft, fired everybody on the spot, and went home in frustration.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Shortage of 30 sealant drums on morning of pipe laying.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Stalling entire workforce leads to cascading deadline failure.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Re-sequenced excavation tasks; negotiated inter-depot loan.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Dispatched transport; liaised with neighbor depot supervisor.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Zero downtime achieved; pipe jointing executed flawlessly.

situation_bank.title: Weather Disruption
situation_bank.description: Unseasonal torrential rain, hail, severe fog, or extreme heat jeopardizes an outdoor transport, sports, or civic operation.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Dark clouded sky, rain-swept background, people sheltering under temporary canopy or inspecting vehicles on muddy road.

best_fit_professions.name: Trekking Guide / Adventure Instructor
best_fit_professions.reason: Assesses route gradient, sets safe perimeter, and pauses ascent at base shelter.

best_fit_professions.name: Agriculture Extension Officer
best_fit_professions.reason: Advises farmers on drainage canals to prevent standing water root rot.

best_fit_professions.name: Disaster Response Lead
best_fit_professions.reason: Coordinates sandbagging, clearing culverts, and establishing alternative communication.

situation_bank.model_story: Karan, a 27-year-old outdoor expedition instructor leading a college mountaineering camp, noticed sudden heavy cloud accumulation and barometric pressure drops indicative of a flash thunderstorm. Instead of pushing for the peak, Karan immediately called a halt at the plateau meadow. He organized the group into buddy pairs, assigned senior students to pitch anchored dome tents in a leeward, elevated grove away from drainage gullies, and gathered all rain-sensitive communication gear in waterproof drybags. He verified headcount, served warm electrolyte soup, and maintained contact with the valley base station via VHF radio until the storm subsided safely three hours later.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan was climbing the mountain when a cyclone struck. Rohan refused to listen to anyone and forced his friends to climb to the summit in the lightning to prove their guts.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Incoming severe storm on exposed mountain terrain.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Hypothermia and lightning strike risks if ascent continued.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Halted group; selected leeward elevated shelter site.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Instituted buddy system; maintained VHF contact with base station.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Entire party kept safe, warm, and accounted for without distress.

situation_bank.title: Lost Person
situation_bank.description: A student, trekker, or vulnerable individual gets separated from the group during a crowded fair, field survey, or forest trail.
situation_bank.picture_cues: A worried group looking into a trail, a leader pointing at a map or handheld radio, forest or crowded market backdrop.

best_fit_professions.name: Forest Beat Officer / Range Guard
best_fit_professions.reason: Applies trail grid search, checks waterpoints, and alerts checkposts.

best_fit_professions.name: School Sports Coordinator
best_fit_professions.reason: Contains remaining students at assembly point while conducting systematic sweep.

best_fit_professions.name: Police Sub-Inspector
best_fit_professions.reason: Broadcasts description over control room, checks CCTV, and seals perimeter exits.

situation_bank.model_story: Neha, a 24-year-old biology research scholar leading a field survey in a wildlife sanctuary, discovered during the mid-day headcount that a junior undergraduate had drifted away from the trail. Neha calmly kept the remaining six students at the designated forest rest house under the care of the local forest guard. Drawing a 1-kilometer grid map based on the student's last photograph timestamp, Neha and two experienced rangers searched along the trail's stream crossing using sound signals. Within 25 minutes, they located the student resting near a rock outcrop after losing the path. Neha checked him for dehydration, safely guided him back, and reinforced mandatory buddy guidelines.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan found a kid lost in the jungle. He suspected wild tigers had eaten the child, so he took a rifle, shot three tigers, and found the boy sleeping peacefully.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Headcount showed one junior student missing on forest trail.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Risk of dehydration or wild encounters if search is delayed.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Secured main party; drafted grid map based on timestamp.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Formed search trio with local rangers; used whistle signals.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Student recovered unharmed within 25 minutes; protocol updated.

situation_bank.title: Conflicting Information
situation_bank.description: Two opposing reports or conflicting instructions arrive regarding an operational order, event venue, or project specification.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Two people presenting competing papers or blueprints to an officer sitting across a desk with a thoughtful expression.

best_fit_professions.name: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM)
best_fit_professions.reason: Verifies ground records, summons both field inspectors, and executes physical inspection.

best_fit_professions.name: Quality Assurance Auditor
best_fit_professions.reason: Checks raw test logs against calibration standards to settle specification variance.

best_fit_professions.name: Investigative Journalist
best_fit_professions.reason: Triangulates primary documentation before publishing public advisories.

situation_bank.model_story: Ankit, a 26-year-old Assistant Municipal Engineer, received conflicting reports: the road contractor claimed asphalt paving was completed to 65mm thickness, while the community vigilance committee reported severe potholes and under-laying. Rather than taking sides, Ankit scheduled an on-site joint verification the following morning. In the presence of both the contractor and resident representatives, he conducted random core drilling samples across three sections of the road. Finding an average thickness of only 42mm, Ankit documented the shortfall in the official inspection book, issued a rectification notice to re-lay the top course at contractor cost, and restored community trust through transparent adherence to standards.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan got two different reports. He arrested both parties for lying to a government official and threw them in jail without verification.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Conflicting claims regarding completed road thickness.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Objective ground truth needed through calibrated measurement.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Organized joint on-site inspection with core-drilling.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Conducted measurement in presence of both parties.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Transparent evidentiary proof obtained; contractor rectified road.

situation_bank.title: Team Delay & Disorganization
situation_bank.description: A project or cultural fest team is lagging far behind schedule because tasks were vague and team members are overlapping and arguing.
situation_bank.picture_cues: A group of young people looking weary around a table covered in half-finished posters, schedules, and disorganized materials.

best_fit_professions.reason: Re-charts milestone timeline, assigns clear single-point responsibilities.

best_fit_professions.name: Software Scrum Master / Team Lead
best_fit_professions.reason: Conducts quick daily standup, clears roadblocks, and implements sprint board.

best_fit_professions.name: College Cultural Secretary
best_fit_professions.reason: Reorganizes committee sub-teams and sets short-interval check-ins.

situation_bank.model_story: Ritu, a final-year engineering student and coordinator for the annual national technical symposium, noticed that with just 48 hours to launch, neither the stage setup nor participant badges were complete. Calling a 10-minute huddle, Ritu listened to the members' confusion regarding overlapping roles. She quickly divided the whiteboard into four distinct pillars: Stage Logistics, Participant Registration, Hospitality, and Technical Sound. Assigning one reliable lead to each pillar with dedicated volunteer lists, she set 3-hour milestone check-ins. Working alongside the registration desk to boost morale, Ritu cleared the badge backlog by evening, enabling the stage team to finish lighting ahead of the inaugural ceremony.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw his team was slow. He shouted at them, called them worthless, did the entire festival work alone overnight without sleep, and collapsed.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: 48 hours to event launch; chaos and overlapping tasks.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Lack of ownership and clear functional division of labor.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Created four functional pillars with assigned leads.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Set 3-hour milestone checkpoints; assisted bottleneck desk.
action_logic_breakdown.result: All preparations synchronized and completed ahead of inaugurations.

situation_bank.title: Community Problem (Water / Sanitation)

situation_bank.model_story: Aditya, a 25-year-old Gram Rozgar Sevak, was alerted by village elders that the primary submersible community pump had burnt out, leaving eighty families without drinking water during harvest week. Aditya immediately contacted the Jal Sansthan junior engineer to log an emergency repair requisition. Recognizing that technical replacement would take 24 hours, he coordinated with the nearby dairy plant to dispatch two food-grade water tankers for morning and evening distribution. Organising youth volunteers to manage orderly queues and prioritize elderly households, Aditya oversaw the pump replacement the following afternoon, ensuring safe, potable water was fully restored without conflict.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the dry well. He started digging with his bare hands for 24 hours straight until water miraculously gushed out of the earth.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Community pump burnt out; 80 families facing water shortage.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Immediate hydration need vs technical repair lead time.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Arranged temporary dairy tankers; logged formal repair order.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Youth volunteers managed orderly distribution for elderly.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Safe water supplied continuously; new pump installed smoothly.

situation_bank.title: Academic / Skill Difficulty
situation_bank.description: A student, junior recruit, or team member struggles to master a complex syllabus module or technical qualification test.

best_fit_professions.reason: Breaks complex mathematical concepts into visual analogies and graded practice.

best_fit_professions.name: Training Instructor
best_fit_professions.reason: Identifies biomechanical or procedural flaw and guides remedial repetitions.

best_fit_professions.name: Senior Software Mentor
best_fit_professions.reason: Pair-programs to explain debugging methodologies and code modularity.

situation_bank.model_story: Manish, a third-year engineering student, noticed his roommate Nikhil struggling intensely with applied thermodynamics and withdrawing from group sessions due to low confidence. Taking initiative after dinner, Manish sat with Nikhil and reviewed his exam papers to diagnose the specific roadblock. Finding that Nikhil understood theory but stumbled on cycle boundary equations, Manish broke down the derivations into visual step diagrams. He organized an hour of daily joint problem-solving each evening, quizzing each other on practical applications. Through consistent positive reinforcement, Nikhil gained clarity, scored well on the semester midterms, and regained his enthusiasm.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw his friend failing. Rohan hacked into the university computer servers at midnight, changed his friend's marks to 100%, and got him an A grade.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Roommate demoralized and struggling with thermodynamics.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Difficulty stems from mathematical formulation, not lack of interest.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Reviewed papers; established daily 1-hour structured practice.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Used visual diagrams and peer problem-solving sessions.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Friend cleared midterm with high confidence; academic gap closed.

situation_bank.title: Workplace Safety Hazard
situation_bank.description: A worker spots an unguarded transmission belt, gas odor, faulty scaffolding clamp, or electrical spark on an active floor.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Industrial worker pointing out a loose cable or pipe joint to the shift manager with protective helmets visible.

best_fit_professions.name: Industrial Safety Officer
best_fit_professions.reason: Executes lockout/tagout (LOTO), evacuates immediate perimeter, and repairs clamp.

best_fit_professions.name: Workshop Foreman
best_fit_professions.reason: Halts lathe operation, tests earth leakage, and replaces cracked guard.

best_fit_professions.name: Chemical Plant Operator
best_fit_professions.reason: Checks scrubbers, turns isolation valves, and sounds localized cautionary alarm.

situation_bank.model_story: Rajesh, a 28-year-old safety engineer at a fabrication yard, observed that wind gusts were destabilizing a three-tier steel scaffolding unit during evening beam welding. Recognizing the imminent tipping danger to six welders aloft, Rajesh immediately blew his safety whistle and instructed the supervisor to halt welding and safely lower all personnel. He cordoned off the 10-meter drop zone with hazard tape, inspected the base jacks, and found that ground settling had loosened two anchoring tie-clamps. Directing the rigging crew to install diagonal bracing and secure ground anchor pins, Rajesh re-tested load rigidity before signing off on work resumption.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the scaffolding collapsing. He ran underneath the falling iron pipes and held up the 50-ton structure on his shoulders until everyone walked away safely.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Scaffolding vibrating and leaning under high wind gusts.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: High-consequence structural collapse hazard to overhead welders.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Blew safety whistle; ordered immediate controlled evacuation.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Cordoned drop zone; directed rigging crew to re-brace foundation.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Scaffolding stabilized and certified; zero injuries or structural damage.

situation_bank.title: Supply Chain / Material Delay
situation_bank.description: An inter-state logistics truck carrying critical components is halted by a landslide, axle breakdown, or toll bottleneck.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Logistics manager on phone examining transport route map on computer screen alongside shipping documentation.

best_fit_professions.reason: Re-routes shipment via alternate highway and coordinates priority clearance.

best_fit_professions.name: Fleet Operations Manager
best_fit_professions.reason: Dispatches secondary recovery vehicle to transfer cargo without detention.

best_fit_professions.name: Pharmaceutical Distribution Lead
best_fit_professions.reason: Monitors cold-chain temperature logs and arranges dry-ice recharge.

situation_bank.model_story: Deepak, a logistics coordinator for a solar installation company, learned that a consignment of 120 inverter units was stranded 80 kilometers from the installation site due to an axle failure on the carrier trailer. With the project commissioning deadline scheduled in 36 hours, Deepak contacted the transport partner's regional hub to dispatch a replacement flatbed with a mobile crane. He notified the site assembly team to advance cable tray preparations and inverter stand mountings while cargo was in transit. Meeting the relief truck at the highway transfer point, Deepak supervised the crane transfer, verified shipment intactness, and ensured arrival on-site by midnight.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan found the truck broken. He pushed the 20-ton truck with his own hands all 80 kilometers down the highway in two hours.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Key inverter shipment stranded due to truck mechanical failure.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Risk of missing critical 36-hour grid commissioning timeline.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Dispatched relief flatbed and mobile crane for cargo transfer.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Re-sequenced site civil work; personally supervised highway transfer.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Components delivered safely with zero delay to grid synchronization.

best_fit_professions.name: Event Operations Director
best_fit_professions.reason: Deploys marshals to widen funnels and redirects foot traffic to secondary lawns.

best_fit_professions.name: Civil Defense Volunteer Captain
best_fit_professions.reason: Forms human chain to protect women and children while guiding crowd flow.

situation_bank.model_story: Saurabh, a 26-year-old Sub-Inspector on security duty at an annual trade exposition, observed a bottleneck forming at the eastern pedestrian exit following the closing fireworks. Sensing increasing pressure against the steel barricades, Saurabh took the public address megaphone and announced in a calm, firm tone that additional western gates were being opened with direct shuttle connectivity. Coordinating swiftly via radio with his perimeter staff, he had reserve gates 4 and 5 unlocked immediately. Stationing constables to form an orderly chevron guide line, Saurabh dispersed the congestion within ten minutes without any stampede or panic.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the crowd pushing. He pulled out his pistol, fired five shots into the air, and lathi-charged the women and children to teach them discipline.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Crowd surge bottlenecking at eastern exit gates.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Crush and stampede hazard if pressure is not vented immediately.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Used PA system to reassure crowd; ordered opening of reserve exits.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Radioed perimeter teams to form guidance funnels to western gates.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Crowd evacuated smoothly and safely without a single casualty.

situation_bank.title: Environmental Hazard (Chemical / Waste)
situation_bank.description: An unexpected sludge leak or agricultural chemical discharge threatens a local irrigation canal or grazing boundary.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Environmental inspectors or villagers looking at discoloration in a stream or pond, taking liquid samples in glass bottles.

best_fit_professions.reason: Samples pH/contaminant levels, implements earthen bunding, and neutralizes spill.

best_fit_professions.name: Pollution Control Board Inspector
best_fit_professions.reason: Traces pipeline source, seals discharge outlet, and enforces corrective remediation.

best_fit_professions.name: Veterinary Medical Officer
best_fit_professions.reason: Treats affected cattle and cordons contaminated watering holes.

situation_bank.model_story: Pooja, an environmental scientific officer with the state pollution board, received an alert regarding unusual frothing and discoloration in a village irrigation canal near an industrial cluster. Arriving promptly with her field kit, Pooja took pH and dissolved oxygen readings, confirming toxic alkaline effluent. She immediately notified the irrigation department to close the downstream weir gates, preventing the runoff from reaching paddy fields. Walking the canal upstream, she traced the discharge to an unsealed retention valve of a textile dyeing unit. Pooja had the valve clamped under official notice, instructed the factory to deploy neutralizing slurry, and verified clean water samples before re-opening the sluice.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the polluted river. He drank the chemical water to prove it was harmless, but then got superpowers.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Discolored, frothing water in vital village irrigation canal.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Imminent threat of toxic damage to downstream standing crops.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Took test samples; ordered immediate closure of downstream weir.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Traced source upstream to dyeing unit; supervised valve sealing.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Agricultural fields protected; factory complied with remediation.

situation_bank.title: Financial / Ledger Discrepancy
situation_bank.description: An internal audit or inventory reconciliation uncovers an unexplained debit balance or missing cash voucher prior to year-end closing.
situation_bank.picture_cues: Accountant or bank manager looking intently at multiple account sheets, calculators, and audit reports late in the evening.

best_fit_professions.name: Chartered Accountant / Internal Auditor
best_fit_professions.reason: Cross-checks bank reconciliation statements and matches invoice timestamps.

best_fit_professions.name: Treasury Officer
best_fit_professions.reason: Reconciles departmental disbursement vouchers against treasury passbook.

best_fit_professions.name: Commercial Branch Manager
best_fit_professions.reason: Audits day-end cash vault balances and isolates clerical posting errors.

situation_bank.model_story: Varun, a 27-year-old assistant audit officer at a regional cooperative bank, discovered a five-lakh rupee mismatch between the central ledger and daily branch cash vouchers during quarterly closing. Remaining calm, Varun refrained from making premature accusations. He initiated a systematic cross-audit, comparing the automated electronic transaction logs against manual cashier day-slips. Within two hours, he identified that a bulk agricultural loan disbursal had been posted twice under an accidental duplicate reference code during a server lag. Varun had the reversal entry posted with senior manager authorization, verified that cash tallies balanced to the rupee, and recommended a dual-auth prompt on the banking software.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan found money missing. He suspected the cashier, took out handcuffs, tortured the cashier until he confessed, and became hero of the branch.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Unexplained mismatch between central ledger and cash records.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Distinguish between fraudulent diversion and system posting glitch.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Cross-referenced manual receipts against electronic core logs.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Liaised with branch manager to authorize reversal entry.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Complete financial balance restored; duplicate validation rule installed.

best_fit_professions.name: Tehsildar / Administrative Magistrate
best_fit_professions.reason: Listens calmly, audits distribution roster, and resolves pending issuance on the spot.

best_fit_professions.name: Electricity Board Assistant Engineer

best_fit_professions.name: Customer Relationship Head

situation_bank.model_story: Praveen, a 26-year-old Tehsildar, noticed a heated argument developing at the taluk public services counter, where thirty farmers were frustrated over delays in drought relief compensation disbursement. Praveen stepped out of his office, invited three senior representatives into the conference room, and listened patiently to their grievances. Inspecting the processing terminal, he discovered that a recent portal update had flagged bank IFSC codes as invalid. Praveen immediately mobilized three data entry operators to manually verify IFSC codes from original passbook photocopies. By afternoon, the first batch of verified payments was authorized, and Praveen established a daily grievance desk to resolve all remaining claims transparently.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the angry mob. He hid inside the bathroom until evening, called a SWAT team, and had the protestors tear-gassed.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Agitated farmers at public counter due to delayed compensation.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Public frustration fueled by lack of explanation and technical glitch.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Invited farmer representatives for calm discussion; checked server log.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Deployed data operators to manually verify invalid IFSC entries.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Disbursements approved same day; public harmony and trust restored.

situation_bank.title: Cyber Security Incident
situation_bank.description: An institution's internal network suffers ransomware activity, unauthorized data exfiltration, or DDoS downtime right before online admissions or bidding.
situation_bank.picture_cues: IT technicians gathered around computer screens showing alert logs, cables in network rack, serious analytical focus.

best_fit_professions.name: Cyber Security Analyst

best_fit_professions.name: Network Operations Center Lead

best_fit_professions.name: IT Director
best_fit_professions.reason: Initiates incident response protocol, informs legal, and manages service continuity.

situation_bank.model_story: Tanvi, a 25-year-old information security engineer at a state university, observed an abnormal outbound traffic spike on the admissions database server three hours before entrance results were to be published. Suspecting an automated SQL injection attempt, Tanvi immediately severed the server's public gateway to contain any breach. Analyzing traffic packets, she identified the malicious IP range and blocked it at the border firewall. Working with her database administrator, she validated data table hashes against the previous night's verified offline backup, confirmed no records were compromised, and reinforced the input query sanitation before restoring public access with enhanced CAPTCHA protection on time.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw a hacker message on the screen. He hacked back into the hacker's computer, destroyed the hacker's computer with a cyber-bomb, and saved the internet.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Unusual outbound network traffic spike prior to major result release.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Potential database exfiltration requiring containment before investigation.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Isolated public gateway; analyzed malicious IP vectors.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Audited cryptographic hashes against offline backup with DBA.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Zero data leaked; input sanitization upgraded; portal launched safely.

best_fit_professions.reason: Installs dewatering pumps, modifies pile foundation depth, and reroutes drainage.

situation_bank.model_story: Arjun, a 28-year-old civil construction engineer overseeing a community primary health center foundation, found that excavation struck an unmapped underground water seepage pocket at 3 meters depth. With trench walls sloughing, Arjun halted digging and instructed the earthmover operator to pull back to stable ground. Consulting the district geological survey report, Arjun designed an immediate dewatering strategy: he deployed two diesel submersible pumps to lower the water head into an adjacent retention pit while ordering perforated gravel trenches along the perimeter. Once stabilized, he revised the foundation design to short friction piles approved by the structural architect, keeping the clinic build secure and on track.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the water leaking into the pit. He jumped in and plugged the underground spring with his boots and held it for 12 hours.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Unmapped groundwater seepage causing trench wall instability.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Risk of structural settlement and excavation collapse.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Halted excavator; deployed diesel dewatering pumps.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Consulted geotechnical records; liaised with structural architect.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Gravel drainage and friction piles installed; building foundation secured.

best_fit_professions.reason: Checks stairwell pressurization, prevents elevator use, and accounts for all rooms.

best_fit_professions.reason: Prioritizes non-ambulatory patient evacuation using wheelbeds and oxygen bottles.

best_fit_professions.reason: Initiates plant shutdown, leads employees to assembly point, and conducts roll call.

situation_bank.model_story: Naveen, a 26-year-old safety marshal in a five-story technical institute, heard the secondary smoke alarm sound on the third floor physics wing. Grabbing his emergency radio and flashlight, Naveen rushed to the floor and identified an electrical smolder in an air handling room. Confirming light smoke entering the hallway, he activated the floor evacuation horn, instructed students to stay calm, and strictly directed them away from the elevators toward the dual external fire staircases. Naveen conducted a sweep of all classrooms and restrooms to ensure no student was left behind, helped an injured student down the stairs, and reported zero missing persons to the arriving fire brigade at the designated assembly ground.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan heard the fire alarm. He took a fire extinguisher, swallowed the smoke, leaped through the flames, and jumped out of the 5th floor window with two people in his arms.

action_logic_breakdown.identify: Risk of stampede and smoke inhalation in multi-story building.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Directed students through external fire stairs; blocked elevators.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Swept all rooms; guided incapacitated student; briefed fire chief.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Entire floor evacuated in under 4 minutes; fire contained safely.

situation_bank.model_story: Kunal, a 27-year-old aircraft maintenance engineer inspecting a regional passenger aircraft prior to morning boarding, noticed micro-pitting along the hydraulic return line of the starboard landing gear. While the warning sensor in the cockpit showed green, Kunal trusted his visual inspection and conducted a non-destructive dye-penetrant test. The test confirmed a hairline stress fracture that could have ruptured under landing impact pressure. Kunal immediately flagged the aircraft as ground-held, alerted flight dispatch to assign an alternate aircraft to prevent passenger delay, and coordinated with his hangar crew to replace the hydraulic assembly, ensuring zero compromise on aviation safety.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the crack in the airplane engine. He flew the plane anyway and held the cracked engine together with his hand during supersonic flight.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: Visual pitting on hydraulic landing gear return line.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Latent crack risk which electronic sensors failed to flag.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Conducted dye-penetrant NDT; grounded craft for flight safety.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Notified dispatch for backup aircraft; replaced hydraulic line.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Zero passenger delay; catastrophic in-flight hydraulic loss prevented.

situation_bank.model_story: Devika, a 26-year-old research chemist developing drought-resistant seed coatings, found that the third trial batch showed a 40% drop in germination speed compared to controls. Resisting the impulse to discard the batch or fudge the graph, Devika initiated an audit of all experimental variables. She recalibrated the environmental growth chamber's humidity sensors and discovered that the chamber's water filtration cartridge had expired, allowing mineral calcification on the germination trays. Devika replaced the filters, ran a standardized control batch alongside the trial, and confirmed that seed vigor restored to optimal targets, documenting the recalibration protocol in the lab registry.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan saw the experiment failed. He poured all chemicals together, created an explosion, and synthesized the cure for all diseases known to mankind.

action_logic_breakdown.observe: 40% drop in germination rate in third seed coating trial batch.
action_logic_breakdown.identify: Determine whether flaw is in chemical formulation or environmental chamber.
action_logic_breakdown.plan_initiate: Audited growth chamber sensors; found expired filtration cartridge.
action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Replaced filters; ran paired control and trial batches.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Accurate experimental repeatability achieved; lab protocol improved.

He coordinated with the municipal transport corporation to arrange ten state buses at the station porch to transfer passengers destined for the airport and city center. Meanwhile, he opened the station water booths, distributed refreshments from the pantry cars, and dispatched the emergency relief train with the engineering gang to re-rail the freight car by noon.

action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Dispatched railway breakdown crane; opened passenger water kiosks.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Passengers evacuated smoothly; track cleared and traffic resumed.

He assembled the team, reviewed the day's primary objective—presenting the catchment runoff contours—and assigned each surveyor their specific sector briefing role. situation_bank.model_story: Harsh, a 23-year-old NCC cadet captain, received word that flash rain had waterlogged a slum settlement near the riverbank, requiring urgent mobilization of food packets and dry clothes. She coordinated with the scheme coordinator to execute a manual biometric override, completed the enrollment paperwork within twenty minutes, and guided them directly to the ophthalmic pre-op ward for same-day evaluation.

action_logic_breakdown.coordinate: Liaised with hospital Ayushman coordinator for biometric override.
action_logic_breakdown.result: Child admitted to surgical ward same morning; financial coverage ensured.

situation_bank.model_story: Kunal, a 27-year-old architectural team lead, received an urgent revision from the municipal health department at 4 PM: the proposed community diagnostic center required an isolated negative-pressure isolation room for airborne pathogens before the 10 AM tender submission. Keeping his team calm, Kunal reviewed the floor plan. Identifying that the storage bay adjacent to the eastern medical corridor had independent exterior wall access, he converted that footprint into the isolation unit, re-routing duct ventilation upward. He delegated the revised CAD detailing and mechanical drafting between his two associates. By 9 PM, the revised blueprints and bill of quantities were validated, printed, and ready for compliant submission.
situation_bank.blunder_story: Rohan was told to change the plan. He threw the computer out the window, sued the client for mental harassment, and retired to the Himalayas.

questions: Does the profession actually matter to the solution?
Is the problem specific rather than vague?
Are actions practical with available resources?
Does the story include appropriate coordination?
Does the protagonist adapt when required?
Is the result realistic rather than heroic or exaggerated?
Does the story avoid unnecessary drama?
Could the same action sequence work in real life?
mistakes_to_avoid: Writing a profession description instead of a story.
Using the same generic action for every profession.
Adding unrealistic authority, resources or outcomes.
Making the protagonist solve everything alone.
Using unnecessary violence or melodrama when a practical solution is available.
Trying to display every OLQ explicitly instead of letting actions demonstrate them.
